text:
Maria: Quick dry-run for Thursday's ML Infra panel — candidate 2. Please confirm AV/recording, scribe, and rubric weighting. I've tentatively set weights: 50% system design, 30% infra ops, 20% culture. Agenda in invite.

Samir: I'm good for 9am PT. AV ok on my end. Quick thought — their public infra work looks stronger than architecture depth; can we shift to 40/40/20 instead?

Lee: AV note — prefer we mute room mic when candidate screenshares (reduces background). I can scribe unless Dakota wants Lee off the scribe.

Dakota: I will handle recording + consent. Candidate already signed. Calendar invite sent (https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123). I also attached the candidate's repo link and sample prompt.

Maria: Thanks. Agenda I put in the invite:
```
Agenda:
- 09:00-09:15 Intro / quick context
- 09:15-10:00 System design deep-dive
- 10:00-10:10 Edge-case follow-ups + wrap
```
Also we need one person to run the short pre-call AV dry-run Wed 5pm PT. @interview-bot can you post the recording & consent checklist?

interview-bot: Reminder: please upload the finalized rubric to /company/interviews/ml-infra/rubric_v3.pdf. Ensure recording consent is verified. Auto-reminder will fire 10m before the panel.

Samir: Uploaded an eval pack (3 prompts) to the invite docs. Suggest we use prompt 2 to test prefix/caching behaviour during the design exercise.

Lee: Agree with Samir. Also propose normalizing "tradeoff reasoning" scoring to 1-5 (more granularity) vs current 1-3. Helps calibration across interviewers.

Maria: Good call — I updated rubric filename to rubric_v3_norm1-5.pdf and noted the scoring change in the doc. @Dakota can you swap the attachment in the invite?

Dakota: Done :white_check_mark:. Rubric replaced, scribe set to Lee, recording set to cloud for 30 days. Consent note added to the invite body.

Samir: I'll be available for a 5-min mic + screen-share test Wed 5pm PT. Ping if anyone needs a different time.

Lee: Can we add a 5-min "edge-case follow-up" slot at the end of the interview for clarifying tradeoffs? Suggest we add a one-liner in debrief template to capture unknowns.

Maria: Added the 5-min slot and a debrief bullet: "uncertainties / follow-up asks". Thanks all — see you Thursday. :tada:
